name: Yourself to Science Catalogue Agent
description: Read-only discovery service for finding citizen-science, biobank, health-data, genomic-data, and biological-sample contribution opportunities.

skills.name: Search contribution opportunities
skills.description: Search and filter the public catalogue by text, country, data type, compensation, category, recruitment status, API availability, and open-data status.
examples: Find actively recruiting genome donation projects available in Italy
List open-data citizen-science resources with an API

skills.name: Get catalogue resource
skills.description: Retrieve a complete catalogue record by stable ID or slug.

skills.name: Inspect catalogue facets
skills.description: Retrieve available countries, data types, compensation types, categories, and recruitment-status counts.
